name: Can accessibility modifications be added during a rental property remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can accessibility modifications be added during a rental property remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding accessibility modifications widens your potential tenant base, accommodating aging renters and individuals with mobility requirements. Upgrades like curbless walk-in tile showers, sturdy blocking inside walls for grab bars, wider framed interior doorways, and zero-threshold transitions make a rental property accessible without looking institutional. HH Remodeling specializes in residential disability and accessibility modifications alongside general finish work, allowing landlords to incorporate functional, safe adjustments seamlessly into their rental kitchens, bathrooms, and entryways.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, upgrades like barrier-free showers, reinforced grab-bar backing, and widened doorways can be integrated smoothly during kitchen and bath renovations.
